data.description:
## Goal

Confirm on the live proxy that the restored liveness-based prefill lease
extension (LP-0MUXQ5QL40027VZ4) stops the kill/retry loop for long local
prefills.

## Context

Fix landed in commit 2ced52ac: `_extend_lease_during_prefill` now extends the
lease on numeric progress advance OR observed slot liveness
(`is_processing`), with the `local_dispatch_max_prefill_seconds` ceiling still
bounding a wedge. Before the fix, `lease_extended_during_prefill` was 0 and
every local prefill >180s was released and cancelled by the no-progress
watchdog, so clients retried into full re-prefills (see LP-0MUXQ5QL40027VZ4).

## Acceptance criteria

1. Over a post-deploy window, `lease_extended_during_prefill` events appear in
   `/var/log/llama-proxy/proxy.log` with `progress=None alive=True` (the b8782
   liveness-only shape), where the pre-fix count was 0.
2. `lease_released ... reason=no_progress_watchdog` count drops sharply versus
   the same-length pre-fix window; `dispatch_first_byte_timeout` and
   `backend_retry ... ReadTimeout` counts drop.
3. Local prefills longer than `local_dispatch_no_progress_timeout_seconds`
   (180s) complete rather than being re-queued repeatedly.
4. A genuinely wedged slot (no progress, no liveness) is still released
   (watchdog reason still fires when appropriate).
5. If (1)-(4) do not hold, roll back commit 2ced52ac from `dev` and record the
   observed evidence.
data.title: Verify liveness-based prefill lease extension on a live post-deploy window
